## Check step

Batch "B3 check", 2026-09-30 22:05–22:45 UTC (resumed after a container restart; an earlier 19:18–19:29 attempt left scratch numbers only and was redone), branch `design/three-films`. **Credits spent: 0.** No Higgsfield call was made and nothing was regenerated. Nothing was written to `public/` or `lib/`, and nothing was committed. The deliverables are staged in `docs/build/media-staged/p3/accepted/`: `<stem>-loop.mp4`, `.webm`, `-poster.webp` and `<stem>-loop.json` for each PASS, and `iconic-express-loop.FAIL.json` for the FAIL. The JSONs hold the full before/after checks, the prompt, the flags and the manifest proposal.

**Method.** All four loops use `loop.mjs seam --method=residual --k=12` with one keyframe per loop and tail boost 2. Frame 0 is the pinned plate frame `src[0]`, and each loop is 144 frames (6.00 s), silent. `check` ran on the master and on both encodes, with `--plate`, the map's static rects and light zones. The L2 sweep looked at frames 0/25/50/75/100% with 100–260% crops (board quadrants at 4× gain, window, chalk ledge; corridor end, courtyard, floor; windows and ribbon; carriages, tender, cab). Motion was measured as Farneback flow and blurred |ΔY| against frame 0. The slit-scans and wrap strips were read on both codecs. SSIM is yuv at 960×540, and "pct" is the share of natural steps that are ≤ the join.

**L09 board-dawn: PASS.**
- **Board.** The interior (left 60% × top 85%) reads 0.50/255 on the WebM and 0.72 on the MP4. It is blank at every sweep point, including the four board quadrants at 100% and 4× gain on frames 72 and 143. The motion map shows no local change on the board interior. The ledge holds only the plate's two chalk sticks.
- **Beam.** Its left edge draws back right by up to 0.020 of the width (38 px) around frames 63–72, then returns. It never spreads left of the plate's edge (≤ 3 px). Below y .70 the plate's own beam edge already sits at x .62–.64, so "right of 65%" holds relative to the plate. The beam zone varies 12.7–12.9% at 0.17 Hz, inside the 15% glow limit.
- **Motion is visible.** The beam narrows and returns, the lit stone jamb shifts a little, and a few faint dust specks drift in the window light.
- **Encode.** The WebM uses CRF 26, not 32: at 5× gain, CRF 32 blotches the dark board texture. It is 173 KB, inside the 0.4 MB tier-I target. The MP4 is 190 KB.

**L10 iconic-corridor: PASS, with a 0-credit hold-out.**
- **Why the hold-out.** The raw master fails the map's STILL zones. The wall reads 1.11/255: a uniform darkening of about 1 unit, with flow ≤ 0.17 px. The columns read 1.84–1.96: texture boil plus a +0.86 brightening, with flow ≤ 0.19 px. A plain seam kept this (wall 1.15 MP4 / 1.07 WebM).
- **The fix** follows the B2 L05 broom-hold precedent. Frame 0 (the pinned plate frame) is composited over the granite wall and over the four nearest column shafts. The wall is held at full height for x ≤ .405, with a smoothstep ramp to .44. The column shafts are cut at the floor line so the moving floor stripes are never held; the masks use a 4 px dilation and σ 4 px. The math is float yuv420p, and the result is `media-src/p3/masters/iconic-corridor-c6481b99-wallcolhold.mkv` (FFV1, gitignored).
- **Result.** The wall reads 0.05 / 0.11 and the columns ≤ 0.19 (MP4 / WebM). A ×8 diff at the frame of peak motion shows the held columns sitting cleanly next to the moving stripes. The slit-scans across the wall ramp and the column edge show no line.
- **Motion.** The pergola shadow stripes creep across the floor and return: floor flow p99.9 up to 16 px, |ΔY| up to 9/255. The trees do not sway, and no dust motes are visible.
- **L2.** At 200%, the corridor, its far opening and the courtyard stay empty in every sweep frame, with no signage.

**L11 lights-line: PASS, flagged near-still.**
- **All limits pass.**
  - Left 40%: 0.21 / 0.48.
  - The ribbon holds its curve for LINE_D: flow p99.9 ≤ 0.28 px, flame centroids ≤ 0.31 px.
  - Glow ≤ 2.6% with 0 reversals/s; 0 flashes.
  - No new lights. The windows show only stars and tracery at 125% and 2.5× gain.
  - At 6× gain, the halos show no banding on the CRF 22 WebM or the CRF 23 MP4.
- **Motion is barely visible.** The candles do not bob, and the 7 large flames vary only 0.5–0.8%. The only motion is a faint, slow shimmer in the 361 small ribbon flames: median 3.5%, max 9.8% peak-to-trough, ≤ 1.2 reversals/s.
  - This is comparable to the shipped MV-09 last-light loop (flame luma 1.4–1.9%), so it passes as a calm candle scene, the way B2's L05 and L08 did.
  - Aryan to judge it against the code ALT (parallax). A livelier retake prompt is in the JSON (`retakeIfWanted`).
- **Residual, not boomerang.** The lossless seam join is already 1.0000, so the map's boomerang option would only double the bytes.

**L13 iconic-express: FAIL, the motion was not delivered.**
- **The frame is a still.** The steam plume, the mist and the loch are frozen. Flow p99.9 is 0.22 px over the whole frame and 0.27 px on the steam. Blurred |ΔY| peaks at 3.6/255 anywhere in the frame. A ×8 diff shows only edge boil.
- **Why FAIL rather than a flagged PASS.** The steam is the plate's hero motion, so this is B1 L03's failure (a frozen fire), not a calm plate. Shipping it would cost 1.0 MB of MP4 and a decode for a picture that matches the poster.
- **Everything else passes:**
  - no figures;
  - no new lettering, numbers or emblems on the carriages, tender or cab (carriages at 200%, engine at 260%); the small gold carriage-end ornaments are the plate's own and are unchanged in every frame;
  - the train is in place (≤ 0.07 px);
  - 0 flashes, silent.
- **Retake prompt** (the steam named as the one continuous, visible motion, pinned on the same upload `d5d4bc0f`) is in the FAIL json.
- **Note for the retake.** The train rects read 1.06–1.53/255 from texture boil. A passing retake may need the L10-style hold-out on the carriage bodies below the steam line.

**Common to all four.**
- 0 audio streams.
- Registration 0.982–0.991 at both ends, phase shift ≤ 0.1 px.
- Smoothness: minimum step ≥ 0.9975.
- The MP4 `pass.join` is `"codec"` on every loop (the known IDR texture refresh). The lossless and WebM joins are 0.9999–1.0000, at or above every natural step.
- The slit-scans across the wrap are continuous on both codecs.
